title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 XXE in the .NET build steps auto-discovery was possible…
description: An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7, specifically in the .NET build steps auto-discovery feature. This vulnerability allows an attacker with limited privileges to cause a denial of service or potentially access sensitive information via crafted XML input.
